column1: # scripts/data/ruled-meadows.tsv -- Meadows leverage-layer classification of RULED 1-244 on pardosa-jn1.
# Produced by mission package pardosa-meadows-1756900000 (epic pardosa-9ar, sub-missions 01-07).
# Annotation only: no ruling, close reason, or comment was edited. Each row is classified from the
# owning bead ruling text, one layer per ruling, first-YES-wins from S downward.
# House layer->tier mapping (authoritative; tier is DERIVED, never chosen independently):
#   1  transcend paradigms                                     -> S
#   2  mindset/paradigm the system arises from                 -> S
#   3  goals of the system                                     -> S
#   4  power to add/change/evolve/self-organize structure      -> A
#   5  rules of the system (incentives, punishments, constraints) -> B
#   6  structure of information flows (who has access)         -> B
#   7  gain around driving positive feedback loops             -> C
#   8  strength of negative feedback loops                     -> C
#   9  lengths of delays relative to rate of change            -> D
#   10 structure of material stocks and flows                  -> D
#   11 sizes of buffers/stabilizing stocks relative to flows    -> D
#   12 constants, parameters, numbers                          -> D
# Prose/numeric tension: adr-fmt prose calls Design "C" while the numeric table puts information
# flows at layer 6 -> B. RESOLVED IN FAVOUR OF THE NUMERIC TABLE for this entire pass.
# Columns (tab-separated): ruled_n
